author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
The new Journal Tactica for the Horus Heresy adds Close Quarters Combat at a small scale to the 31st Millennium. Take to a 4x3' board with 1500pt armies and new Detachments in this new game format in the same vein as Boarding Actions for your Horus Heresy games! Let's check it out.

Big thanks to Games Workshop for the complimentary copy of the book to review.
